CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.TITLE: Assistants
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.DESCRIPTION: Configure account-owned AI Assistants and connect published Assistants to Website Inboxes.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create an Assistant, configure its draft, publish it, then connect it to a Website Inbox.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.SELECT_PROMPT: Select an Assistant to configure it.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.NAME: Name
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.MODEL_FIXED: The supported model is controlled by the server.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.ARCHIVE_CONFIRM: Archive this Assistant? Native Inbox bindings will be drained and disabled.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.RELEASE_CLOSED: Public AI is still disabled. You can configure and publish Assistants, but new Inbox connections remain locked until the production release gate passes.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.INBOX_DESCRIPTION: Chatwoot remains authoritative for Inbox ownership, conversation assignment, messages and delivery.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.DISABLE_CONFIRM: Disable this Assistant connection? Bot-owned conversations will be handed off through native Chatwoot behavior.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.PREFLIGHT_READY: This Inbox is ready to connect.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED: Resolve the blocking native Chatwoot conflicts before connecting.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.SECRET_DESCRIPTION: Rotate the native managed AgentBot secret. The secret is never displayed.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.FAILURES_DESCRIPTION: Operational metadata only. Customer messages, prompts, evidence text and credentials are not exposed here.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.NO_TURNS: No AI turns recorded for this Assistant.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.ERROR: Unable to complete the Assistant operation.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.STALE_DRAFT_PRESERVED: This draft changed in another session. Your unsaved edits are preserved; reload the latest draft before saving again.
CHATRING_ASSISTANTS.SAVE_BEFORE_PUBLISH: Save the current draft before publishing.

CONFLICT.PUBLIC_AI_RELEASE_CLOSED: Public AI release gate is closed
CONFLICT.UNSUPPORTED_CHANNEL: Only Website Inboxes are currently certified
CONFLICT.MANAGED_AGENT_BOT_OWNED_NON_PENDING_CONV: The current bot owns conversations that cannot be safely switched
CONFLICT.AUTOMATION: A native Automation can also respond or change ownership
